chunks: And whoever comes with an evil deed, their faces will be cast down into the Fire. Can you be recompensed except for what you used to do?

key_terms.فَكُبَّتْ: And they will be cast down/flung

ai.seo_question: What is the fate of those who bring evil deeds according to Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the justice of Allah by linking the physical posture of humiliation—being cast face-forward—to the spiritual state of those who prioritized worldly desires over divine guidance. It reinforces the principle of 'Adl' (divine justice), ensuring that punishment is strictly proportional to individual deeds without arbitrary excess, a key tenet distinguishing Shia theology from other schools.
